verdictReason: Phase 11 certified end-to-end. Kayla evolved from a conversational website assistant to a grounded, read-only, task-oriented FDS site copilot. 17-goal taxonomy + UNKNOWN fallback with page context awareness, topic shift detection, and anaphor resolution implemented and 100% verified (38/38 cases). Strict action safety validator created enforcing allowed action types, blocking forbidden side-effect actions (payments, form posts, accounts, executable runs), and verifying canonical internal routes and external domains (42/42 task eval cases passed). Deterministic task planner created with multi-step guidance, action prioritization, tradeoff resolution, false premise defense, and bounded actions (max 3 actions per turn). Check 11 added to drift detector with 18 task goals verified. Golden query suite expanded to 322 queries with 100.0% accuracy across all tiers without provider reliance (Tier 1: 133/133, Tier 2: 152/152, Tier 3: 37/37). 4 new Vitest suites added (699/699 tests passing across 45 files). Playwright E2E suite updated with newcomer journey, developer journey, goal switching, mobile viewports (390px/320px), and keyboard navigation (32/32 tests passing across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit). Cloudflare Worker deployed to production (version 7128796f-39d2-4b5d-ad6b-d170802c70a5) with live knowledgeVersion be8d05ff146c8c98 verified.
